summary.text: Lindsey Williams is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, representing District 38 since December 1, 2018, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Thomas West.

paragraphs.text: Lindsey Williams succeeded Republican Randy Vulakovich in District 38 and is also a member of the Pennsylvania State Board of Education.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
